description.value: Field & Social is a salad-focused fast-casual restaurant founded in Vancouver in 2016, built around the idea that salads can be the main event — filling, flavourful, and worth craving. The Mount Pleasant location serves creative salads and bowls made with fresh-cut greens, scratch-made dressings, and locally sourced proteins and produce. It's a practical lunch stop for cyclists moving through the South Main corridor, with online ordering and pickup available.
